name: Rubik's Phantom Cube 3x3
description: The Rubik’s Phantom Cube 3x3 is not your ordinary 3x3. This heat-sensitive Rubik’s Cube uses innovative thermochromic technology that reveals hidden colors when touched, then fades back to black as the cube cools. It’s a challenge like no other, a race against time and memory that puzzle fans will love.
features: Official Rubik’s Cube 3x3 with heat-sensitive tiles
Designed for experienced cubers and puzzle enthusiasts
A standout addition to your Rubik’s Cube collection
Doubles as a stress-relieving fidget toy for teens and adults
